# GitHub repository owner setup

This repository contains CI workflows and Copilot review instructions. A workflow cannot enable Copilot automatic reviews by itself.

1. Confirm the repository is eligible for Copilot code review under the account's current plan and policies.
2. A repository administrator can configure repository-level automatic review under **Settings → Copilot → Code review**, if organization/enterprise policy allows it. Organization owners may instead configure a ruleset that automatically requests Copilot review for targeted repositories.
3. Decide whether new pushes and draft pull requests should be reviewed automatically. Check billing/credit implications and current plan terms before enabling them.
4. Open a test pull request and verify that Copilot appears as a reviewer and posts a review. Until an owner confirms this, describe Copilot review as a setup task, not an enabled feature.

See GitHub's current [Copilot code review configuration guide](https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/how-tos/copilot-on-github/set-up-copilot/configure-code-review) and [review usage guide](https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/how-tos/use-copilot-agents/use-code-review).
